_comment: Captions for an Instafill vertical Short whose picture fills the content band (frame y 320..1600) and keeps YouTube's title zone (under 1600) for ground only: small one-line cards in a TOP band, under the brand strip (y 40..130) and above everything the voice names. Dark glass card, white words, emerald #34D399 on the word being spoken -- not the navy slab and #78A7FF of instafill-short.json. First used on agent-merge-pdf-short.

overlays._note: Colour of the SOURCE video's own lower-third graphics to dodge, not the colour of this card. A screencast has none, so there is nothing to dodge.
